purpose: Record externally inspected historical cartographic artifacts without promoting them to canonical geometry.

records.title: 14. yüzyıl başında Anadolu Türk Beylikleri haritası
records.rights: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 as stated by SALT Research
records.reason: The artifact is explicitly described as a beginning-of-14th-century map, not a date-specific 1326 boundary source. The stated no-derivatives condition also prevents treating transformed/georeferenced derivatives as an unrestricted production source.

records.title: Harita 2. Eşrefoğulları Beyliği Sınırları (Alperen, 2001)
records.description: The published figure distinguishes the beylik centre, settlements, an approximate widest extent and territories temporarily attached. The paper also reports the broad regional extent in narrative form.

promotionLocks: No canonical promotion from reference-only cartography
